away.summary: The Ottawa Senators are looking to start their season with a win against the Toronto Maple Leafs. Linus Ullmark is confirmed to start in goal, while several key players are out due to injury or suspension. Jake Sanderson is returning to the lineup after missing part of training camp due to an undisclosed injury.

home.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs are coming off a 2-1 win against the New York Islanders. Sergei Bobrovsky is confirmed to start in goal, and the team will dress the same 18 skaters they used in the previous game. Several players are out due to injury, but there are no notable doubtful players.
